title: Exploring the interactions of urinary metals and the mediating role of oxidative stress in Parkinson's disease risk: an epidemiological study in the elderly
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, 27,1439-1447
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00166H, Paper
Chiqun Shan, Quanzhi Zheng, Mengyan Li, Yiming Ge, Junye Bian, Zhihong Huang, Zhihui Guo, Yuxuan Jiang, Pan Xu, Shaoyou Lu, Haobo Chen
Parkinson's disease (PD) is the second most common neurodegenerative disease and metals was implicated in the pathogenesis of PD. We investigated the overall effect and interaction of metal mixtures on PD and the mediating role of oxidative stress.
